jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior QA Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible . We live remote-first within Germany, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations. Contabo serves 180,000+ customers worldwide across VPS, dedicated servers, object storage and a growing cloud-native platform. Quality isn't a bottleneck function here – it's embedded in how we build. You'll work across multiple development teams on products that vary significantly in architecture, maturity and risk profile. The scope is wide and the technical surface is real. QA here means jumping between contexts and figuring things out, not just executing scripts against a stable codebase. You come in before development starts: read the requirements, flag what's untestable and push back early. You own the test strategy and update it as things change – not as a document exercise, but because the products actually change. You write test plans and test cases, run manual tests (functional, regression, exploratory, UAT) and build and maintain automated tests across UI, API and integration. We use AI tools actively: in development, in testing, in how we work day to day and we expect the same from you. That's not a trend we're chasing: it's how we stay fast without cutting corners on quality. You keep the continuous testing pipelines running and help the teams use them. When bugs come up, you write bug reports that developers can actually work with – reproduction steps, impact, everything needed to close it without a follow-up ping. Regular regression cycles after major releases are part of the job, as is running UAT with product stakeholders. What convinces us Your personality, paired with: 5+ years in software testing/QA, ideally in agile teams Test automation in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; hands-on with frameworks like Playwright, Frisby, or Supertest Experience using AI-assisted tools in development or testing (AI code generators, LLM-based test support or similar) and comfortable using Claude (or comparable LLMs) as part of your daily workflow Solid grasp of test design, QA processes, and translating requirements into test plans and test cases API testing (REST), Git, bug tracking, browser DevTools – these are daily tools for you Comfortable prioritizing across multiple test streams simultaneously Fluent English skills and German language skills would be a plus Experience with AI-assisted tools in testing or development UAT facilitation, QA process ownership, performance/integration testing We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference. Awesome Prospects At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. jobs.description: Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap. This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate. WHAT’S THE ROLE? We’re looking for a Senior QA Tester who will be responsible for testing Frontier’s games throughout all phases of development, from pre-production through post-release content. In this role, you’ll work on medium-to-high-risk features, designing and executing comprehensive test suites, and conducting both regression testing and playtesting. Leveraging QA experience, you’ll proactively identify and resolve issues, provide guidance to QA team members and recommend and implement improvements. Depending on project needs, you may also assume Assistant Lead or Team Lead responsibilities for specific phases or entire projects. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Write, run and maintain medium-to-high risk test specifications and suites for new and existing projects, ensuring efficient time reporting and estimates on given tasks and written suites. Conduct playtesting using a variety of test personas e.g. destructive testing and player-like testing. Envision user stories and gather data with provided instructions. Identify and report issues in a clear and accurate manner. Perform regression testing for both internal and external issues. Act as point of contact for specific features, regularly collaborating with cross-discipline teams to gather and relay relevant information back to QA. Provide guidance and technical mentoring to other testers, including guidance on their documentation and advanced troubleshooting of other testers on the project. Raise potential future hurdles for testing, pre-empt problems, and suggest best fixes and ideas for further testing. Contribute to product information, identification of problem areas and analysis of trends to anticipate and navigate risks. WHAT YOU’LL BRING Significant QA experience in the games industry and a strong understanding of QA tools, procedures, methodologies and workflows. Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Experience aligning testing with requirements, managing priorities and successfully collaborating across disciplines/teams. Proven leadership or mentoring experience. BONUS IF YOU HAVE Ability to drive innovation and continuous improvement. Proven ability managing people. We have the product, vision, and team to make life better for performers, venues, and fans, and build a generational consumer brand in the process. All we’re missing is you.
